## Promised scope

- [ ] One deliverable that can be demonstrated on Friday
- [ ] Tests planned
- [ ] Reference paper / benchmark: Rx

## Definition of Done (all required)

- [ ] One PR merged (title = sprint title)
- [ ] Tests green locally and in CI
- [ ] One new artefact committed
- [ ] One README paragraph updated
- [ ] `docs/sprints/wNN.md` written
- [ ] Tag `wNN` + `CHANGELOG.md` entry

## Wednesday scope check

- [ ] On track, or scope cut by 30% now (not on Friday)
